userGuide.rationale: Reviewed the complete v0.24.0-to-candidate range against the 0.24.1 notes. The guide was already updated in the feature commits: docs/user/workspace.md describes Above Full Screen on Windows and macOS, the Dock's own Surface Opacity and the Dock Views order; docs/user/faq.md describes the macOS full-screen Space overlay and Reserve Space boundaries; docs/user/cli.md covers Dock surface opacity. Status notice placement and the removed hover tip are not documented behaviour. No promise or non-goal changed, so docs/prd.md is unchanged. No further edit was needed in the release commit.

website.rationale: Homepage copy makes no claim about full-screen windows or Dock opacity; its Dock section shows the default and custom strips, which remain accurate. Generated Docs pick up the already-updated guide chapters at deployment. Sharesets pages will render Requires PLVS 0.24.1+ for Items using dockAboveFullScreen or dockSurfaceOpacity, now registered at 0.24.1. Privacy impact over baseline 3ffe6f859fafd2affaeae592f96cfbef8a43e018 to candidate a8eb2c81c7b13e5a4810a0121d4f8b751deba00f: the new Preset and Dock fields are stored locally and exported only in user-initiated portable Presets; full-screen detection uses local Windows Shell, taskbar and WinEvent/mouse hooks to decide strip placement and keeps nothing; the macOS tauri-nspanel plugin is a local window class with no network use. No change to collection, consent, upload payloads, recipients, providers, storage outside the profile, retention or deletion. Feedback, crash reporting, newsletter and update-service code and configuration are unchanged; the policy text and its effective date are retained.

screenshots.rationale: The homepage images are recipe renders of app panels from measured fixtures. No panel renderer, theme or layout code changed in the range. The only shared CSS change routes the Dock fill through --dock-surface-opacity, which defaults to 100% like the previous --surface-opacity, and clears the body fill under a docked strip, so the rendered Default and Custom Dock and the hero are unchanged. Status notice placement and Dock Views order appear in no published image.
